name: 위시켓

buyer.notes: The client pays only the project cost plus 10% VAT; premium services cost extra (official price page).

fees.notes: 외주(도급) partner fee from the official price page, read 2026-10-25: 25% of a project under 5,000,000 KRW and 20% of one at 5,000,000 KRW or more, charged on the whole amount; Prime and Pro partners pay a flat 20%. A business partner receives the rest plus VAT, so no VAT is charged on the fee. 기간제(상주) projects pay 10%.

bidCost.notes: Applying is free; the fee arises only once a contracted project proceeds (official price page).

splitMechanism: At signing the client deposits the contract amount with 위시켓, which holds it until the project ends and then pays the partner (대금보호시스템, official partner guide). Whether a contract can pay an advance (선급금) in stages is unverified: the help article on it no longer opens.

contactPolicy.notes: The terms (제10조 (4), in force since 2024-03-25) bar requesting or entering on 위시켓, without its prior consent, anything that makes a member easy to identify: a trade or personal name, a logo or other mark, an address, a phone number or an e-mail address, and any publication or external link that carries them. Proposing or accepting a deal that bypasses 위시켓, an indirect one included such as asking for a quote for a direct deal, is barred for one year from the project's registration. identity forbidden makes the gate block the operator's names in every outbound item.

forbidden: contacting another member directly to propose a direct deal or to advertise (terms 제10조)
macro programs that infringe or may infringe others' rights (terms 제10조 (7))
automation.notes: No rule on automated reading or on AI-written applications was found in the terms; reads stay at descriptor pacing, and nothing is sent while the apply form is unmapped. Profile onboarding (src/platforms/wishket/onboarding.mjs, mapped 2026-10-26): about an hour after a skills cleanup wrote at the 30 actions an hour pacing, the site signed the operator out, as it did upwork and freelancer.com driven the same hour; profile writes now go at most 10 a run, 30 s apart, and a run stops at the first login page.

aiPolicy: The terms say nothing about AI. 위시켓 itself offers PRIME and PRO partners application content that its AI writes from their profile (official partner grade page), so an AI-assisted proposal is a service the platform provides; no disclosure rule was found.
taxInvoice: A business partner issues a tax invoice for the amount it receives; an individual partner has 3.3% withheld and 위시켓 files the tax for them (official price page). The terms count a tax invoice issued at will, late or not at all as obstruction of business (제10조 (5)).

projects.form: An application carries an amount, a period and its content, with related portfolio items attached; the contract amount and period can still change at the meeting (official partner guide). The signed-in form itself, its character limits and any pre-screening questions are unmapped.
projects.meetings: A client can ask up to 4 applicants for a meeting and reviews applicants for up to 10 days after recruiting closes (official partner guide).
projects.privateMatching: 프라이빗 매칭 projects show their text only to PRIME, PRO and BOOST partners, and PRIME and PRO partners apply to them without restriction. PRO for an individual, team or sole-proprietor partner takes a written introduction and skills, at least 5 public portfolio items, a public career entry, 3 contracts, 10,000,000 KRW contracted in total and 3,000,000 KRW in the last 6 months, a high rating, a low dispute rate and no breach of the terms in 12 months (official partner grade page, criteria dated 2024-07-01); BOOST is a membership applied for through 위시켓.
